title: How a client discovers what an API accepts

steps.label: OPTIONS
steps.note: DRF answers OPTIONS with metadata: the view's name and description, and for POST every field with its type, whether it's required and its limits.

steps.label: OpenAPI schema
steps.note: drf-spectacular generates an OpenAPI document from your serializers and views. Swagger UI, ReDoc and Postman (Import → OpenAPI) all read it.
